items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: On that day, Jimmy, in Newark, when people started calling, like Quincy Jones or whoever

ctx.x: On that day, Jimmy, in Newark, when people started calling, like Quincy Jones or whoever – I think a lot of people called – and it all began because it was reported on the radio that you were dead. Here you are talking on the radio. You come down to the station. You get some gigs. Did it renew your spirit?
Yes, it helped a lot. It helped a lot.
